pages.text: A radio's own little speaker plays 80% of the voice band, a bit thin. Place a speaker $(thing)touching$() the radio (any side, on top too) and it sounds better; only the best one counts.$(li)$(item)Desk speaker$() (eleven woods) or $(item)large speaker$(): 90%.$(li)$(item)Premium speaker$() (iron, gold or marble): the whole band, as clean as it gets.

pages.title: Wired speakers
pages.text: A $(item)wall speaker$() or $(item)loudspeaker$() goes on the radio's $(l:radiocraft:power/wire)power wire$(/l), which doubles as the speaker line, and plays the radio where it stands, static and all. As many as you like can share one radio, and they use no power.$(li)Wall speaker: 80%, a little rough.$(li)Loudspeaker: loud and distorted, heard out to 64 blocks. It has no recipe yet.
Each desk speaker takes its own wood's planks.
Gold ingots make the gold speaker, calcite the marble one.
